title: Playboy Magazine December 1987 Gala Christmas Brigitte Nielsen Gore Vidal
conditionDescription: Pre-owned issue, complete. Normal signs of age and storage; possible light edge wear, corner wear, surface marks or creases. Please review the photo for exact condition. The centerfold has not been separately verified - please ask before buying if that matters to you.
descriptionText:
Vintage Playboy Magazine, December 1987 - Gala Christmas Issue. Cover price $4.00.

Features:
- Brigitte Nielsen warms up winter - cover and pictorial
- The Lost Chapter of Catch-22
- Jessica Hahn Part Two: The Cover-Up
- Interview: Gore Vidal
- Sex Stars of 1987
- Plus Gahan Wilson, Ray Bradbury, Ed McBain, Justine Bateman and Dennis Quaid
